facts.fact: Recommended events are not sent automatically by Google Analytics and must be added to a website or mobile app.
facts.quote: Because these events require additional context to be meaningful, they're not sent automatically.

facts.fact: Google recommends sending recommended events with their prescribed parameters to get the most detail in reports.
facts.quote: You should send recommended events with their prescribed parameters to get the most details in your reports

facts.fact: Google recommends the 'For all properties' events to all customers in all business verticals.
facts.quote: We recommend these events to all customers in all business verticals.

facts.fact: The 'For all properties' list includes the ad_impression event, which fires when a user sees an advertisement and applies to apps only.
facts.quote: sees an advertisement, for apps only

facts.fact: The online sales event set is listed by Google as useful for retail, ecommerce, education, real estate, and travel.
According to Google, sending the online sales events populates the Ecommerce purchases report.
Google lists the lead generation event set as useful for business-to-business sales, automotive sales, insurance sales, or offline conversions.
facts.quote: They're useful for business-to-business sales, automotive sales, insurance sales, or generally for when conversions occur offline.

facts.fact: According to Google, sending the lead generation events populates the Lead acquisition report.
